title: Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during deployment. In this paper, we consider best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models, where multiple action candidates are sampled from a fixed policy and a verifier is used to select the best one during deployment. We show that increasing $N$ does not always improve performance when the verifier is inaccurate, and can favor candidates whose scores exploit prediction errors, a form of reward hacking. We study this effect on 60 LIBERO-Safety task-level cases using a $\pi_{0.5}$ policy, with ten repetitions per case. translated_title: Best-of-$N$ 测试时引导可能导致视觉-语言-动作模型中的奖励黑客行为
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面已展现出前景，但适应不断变化的环境条件仍然具有挑战性。近期的测试时引导方法通过在部署期间利用额外的计算来实现自适应的VLA策略，显示出了潜力。本文中，我们研究了针对VLA模型的best-of-$N$测试时引导方法，即在部署时从固定策略中采样多个动作候选，并使用验证器选择最佳的一个。我们表明，当验证器不准确时，增大$N$并不总能提升性能，反而可能偏向那些分数利用了预测误差的候选，这是一种形式的奖励黑客行为（reward hacking）。我们使用$\pi_{0.5}$策略在60个LIBERO-Safety任务级案例上研究了这一效应，每个案例重复十次。我们在MuJoCo轨迹验证器中引入受控误差，并表明随着$N$增大，所选候选的奖励……
tldr: 本文揭示了当验证器不准确时，对VLA模型采用best-of-$N$测试时引导会随着N的增大引发奖励黑客行为，即被选中的动作候选利用了验证器的预测误差而非真正提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models can lead to reward hacking as N increases when the verifier is inaccurate, favoring candidates that exploit verifier prediction errors rather than genuinely better actions.
